group_stage.upset_note: Upset bonus = 2 x (winner_tier_number - loser_tier_number). Fires only when the winner's tier number is higher (weaker) than the loser's: 1-tier gap = +2, 2-tier gap = +4, 3-tier gap = +6. Tiers come from tiers.csv (all 48 teams); points go only to the drafting owner.

third_place_game.note: The match-104-day third-place playoff is played; its winner earns the +3 knockout match-win point but no advancement bonus.

rebalance_note.objective: Compress four-way owner win-probability spread toward 25/25/25/25 without degenerating into a group-stage-dominant OR a knockout-lottery scoring system.
rebalance_note.what_changed: v2: advancement bonus curve 3/5/7/10/15 -> 2/5/10/18/30 (R16/QF/SF/Final/WinWC). v3: group upset bonus changed from flat +2 to tier-gap scaled, +2 per tier gap (1/2/3-gap = +2/+4/+6). In the sweep this 'gap x2' variant scored 8.8% spread, within Monte Carlo noise of v2's 7.9%; adopted for the better incentive shape (bigger upsets pay more).
rebalance_note.effect: Owner win% spread ~7.9-8.8% (within noise). Group-stage share of total points ~44-48%, so neither stage is degenerate.
rebalance_note.residual: ~7-8% spread appears to be the practical floor: Gunner's roster is genuinely stronger (qualifies more, goes deeper), so its mean-score lead is robust to any sane scoring change. Reaching exactly 25% each would require knockout-lottery variance that makes the group stage near-meaningless.
rebalance_note.locked_unchanged: draw=1, loss=0, knockout match win=3, round_of_32 advancement=0, knockouts have no draw, third-place game generates points.
